result.reason: Section 11.4 reaches the preferred position: Corio may terminate on 30 days' written notice, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and Commerce One has no convenience-termination right during a committed term. However, the newly added Section 11.3 is unnecessary to implement the playbook and materially changes unrelated survival, customer-use, payment, maintenance, and confidentiality obligations. In addition, the undefined right to terminate 'in whole or in part' is broader than required. Section 11.4 is generally clear, but these additions and the typo 'it's then-existing Customers' reduce drafting quality.
